title.es: La loma antes de los registros

place: Llandough hill, above the River Ely

present.B_JOHN: the Iron Age elder (c. 200 BC); a Romano-British farmer (c. AD 200); invented faces
present.A_MARY: the roundhouse mother; the farmer's wife; invented faces

logline: One hill, two moments four hundred years apart: an Iron Age family at their roundhouse bring in the corn and ready for winter; then a Romano-British farmer and his wife harvest spelt on the same slope.
accent: thick South Wales Welsh for every character; no narrator; no fourth wall
